Cisco Patches Actively Exploited ASA and FTD VPN Flaw That Can Crash Firewalls
stories.abstract: Cisco has released patches for a high-severity vulnerability, CVE-2026-76418, affecting Secure Firewall ASA, FTD, and Smart Software Manager On-Prem. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger a denial-of-service condition and is currently being actively exploited in the wild.
stories.why: The vulnerability is under active exploitation and has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, indicating a high risk of compromise.
stories.action: Update Cisco Secure Firewall ASA, FTD, and Smart Software Manager to the latest patched versions immediately.

Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores
stories.abstract: A critical access bypass vulnerability within Drupal Commerce Core is currently being exploited in active attacks. Administrators are advised to review order logs for unauthorized activity and ensure their installations are fully patched against this flaw.
stories.why: Exploitation of e-commerce platforms directly threatens transaction integrity and sensitive customer data, necessitating immediate incident response and audit procedures.
stories.action: Update Drupal Commerce Core and audit order logs for unauthorized access.

stories.title: ThreatsDay: Critical Firewall Flaws, Banking Trojans Rented, Weaponized PDF, Token Theft + 26 More Stories
stories.abstract: Recent security reports highlight a persistent mix of sophisticated exploitation techniques and basic operational failures. Attackers are increasingly leveraging AI to accelerate campaigns, while simultaneously exploiting legacy vulnerabilities and abusing trust in common software applications to bypass traditional defenses.
stories.why: The combination of automated tooling and reliance on legacy infrastructure significantly lowers the barrier for entry for threat actors targeting enterprise environments.

stories.title: Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
stories.abstract: Chainalysis reported a security breach involving unauthorized access to its internal systems. The incident exposed limited customer identity information, though the company confirmed that sensitive investigation data, user credentials, and session tokens remained secure from the intruder.
stories.why: Unauthorized access to internal tools at a major blockchain forensics firm poses significant risks to sensitive client data and operational integrity.

stories.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
Wireshark 5.0.0rc1 Release, (Sat, Oct 31st)
stories.abstract: Wireshark has released a candidate for version 5.0.0, signaling an upcoming major update to the network protocol analyzer. Additionally, the YARA-X project has issued versions 1.22.0 and 1.22.1, which include a series of bug fixes and performance improvements.
stories.why: Major version releases often introduce significant architectural changes and new features that may impact existing packet analysis workflows or security monitoring integrations.

stories.title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts
stories.abstract: Attackers compromised a third-party website monitoring tool to inject malicious code into Polymarket. This supply chain breach allowed unauthorized actors to hijack active user sessions and drain over $2 million in cryptocurrency from trader accounts before the platform intervened.
stories.why: This highlights the significant risk third-party dependencies pose to web application integrity and user asset security.

stories.title: MongoDB security advisory (AV26-1107)
stories.abstract: Progress has patched a resource consumption vulnerability in Telerik Document Processing Libraries, specifically within RadWordsProcessing, tracked as CVE-2026-118035. This flaw could allow attackers to trigger excessive resource usage, potentially impacting system availability.
stories.why: Uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerabilities can lead to denial-of-service conditions, disrupting critical business applications that rely on Telerik document processing components.
stories.action: Update Telerik Document Processing Libraries to version 2026.3.1027 or later.

Tell HN: Scribd Breached
stories.abstract: Scribd confirmed a data breach involving unauthorized access to user information across its platforms, including Slideshare, Everand, and Fable. Compromised data includes email addresses, payment history, and partial credit card details, specifically the last four digits, issuer, and expiration dates.
stories.why: Users should anticipate an increase in targeted phishing campaigns leveraging the leaked email addresses and payment-related metadata.

stories.why: It demonstrates the critical risk of endpoint security for personnel with administrative access to production environments and sensitive infrastructure.
